title: camelina sativa subsp. dentata
intro: Camelina sativa subsp. dentata, commonly known as dentate false flax or false flax, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions, such as arthritis and gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of C. sativa subsp. dentata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of C. sativa subsp. dentata make it a promising subject for further research in the fields of medicine and nutrition.
